text:
maria: Quick non-work poll: whos up for a tiny postcard + mug swap? No pressure, just vibes. Ill start the chain with a fuzzy sock photo. :socks:

lee: count me in for postcards! also can we do a tiny tag rule so people don't get spammy? :raised_hand:

maria: yeah one tag per person, match by time zone if possible. tag @toni to keep it going.

toni: I'm in. heres a pic of my chaotic holiday mug collection (some mugs have opinions). Happy winter everyone. tagging @kevin. :mug:

kevin: that mug is judging your snack choices. also 100% down for postcard swap. small ask: id like to do a local pickup option for folks in SF for the mug part to avoid shipping. anyone nearby?

lee: im SF-adjacent, can help coordinate dropoffs. can we use a Google form for addresses? dev-bot, any objections to collecting addresses in a form? :clipboard:

dev-bot: reminder: do NOT post personal addresses in public channels. Use the company form (linked below) or DM. Form: https://forms.example/redwood-holiday.

maria: thanks dev-bot! organizer note: totally optional, no pressure. postcard-only option is fine. Also, tiny tradition idea: write one warm memory from the year on the card. Keeps it cozy and low-key. :sparkles:

toni: love that. my memory: our little plant adoption table saving a stray succulent. your turn, @kevin?

kevin: favorite memory: late-night deploys that actually worked first try and the team pizza after. Cheesy but true. tagging @maria to pass the chain back and invite one more person to join the swap.

maria: tagging @lee to finalize signups. also quick logistics: postcard deadline Dec 18, mug handoffs Dec 20-22 in SF (optional). Please RSVP on the form with preferences. happy almost-holiday everyone :) :evergreen_tree:
